philosophy.quote: Why we don't eat the root
philosophy.body: Elohim Bio harvests only the leaves and stems — the sprout — of ginseng, balloon flower and garlic. Far more active compounds concentrate in the sprout than in the root, and the body absorbs them dramatically better. This is our philosophy, and our difference.
points: Active compounds concentrate in the sprout, not the root

incubator.title: Incubator Farming
incubator.subtitle: Not a single drop of water wasted
incubator.body: A special film completely isolates the growing environment, blocking nematodes and pathogens. The crop absorbs nearly all of the nutrient solution. Versus conventional bench cultivation it cuts water and fertilizer use by over 80% — while raising compound content hundreds of times.

philosophy.title: Learning from Nature, Perfecting with Science
philosophy.body: Elohim Bio combines the power of sea and land. Chitin and chitosan bio-fertilizer extracted from crab by-products awakens the soil's potential, while incubator farming maximizes the plant's capabilities. Our philosophy is to work with nature, elevating it through science.

ceo.name: Lee Chun-gil
ceo.title: CEO / Founder
ceo.bio: Since 1989, CEO Lee Chun-gil has devoted himself to agricultural technology development. He gained recognition with the development of square cucumbers and Taegeuk cucumbers in 1997, then spent over 30 years researching marine bio-fertilizers and incubator farming. In 2023, he succeeded in developing Sinsaengssam containing 800 times more Ginsenoside F2 than regular ginseng, opening new horizons in the functional crop market.

incubator.title: Incubator Farming
incubator.subtitle: Isolated Growing System with Specialized Film
incubator.description: Crops are grown in a sterile environment isolated by specialized film. This completely blocks nematodes and pathogens while precisely controlling nutrients and moisture to maximize active compound content. Uses 80% less water than conventional farming with zero pesticide use.
advantages: Complete pathogen and nematode barrier with specialized film
Precision nutrient control maximizes active compounds

fertilizer.title: Crab Marine Bio-Fertilizer
fertilizer.subtitle: Chitin & Chitosan-based Organic Fertilizer
fertilizer.description: Chitin and chitosan are extracted from red crab by-products (shells) from Korea's East Coast, fully decomposed into liquid and powder bio-fertilizers. These fertilizers boost plant immunity and promote active compound synthesis. Processing 4,500 tons of crab by-products annually also contributes to resource circulation.

sinsaengssam.name: Sinsaengssam (Sprout Ginseng)
sinsaengssam.tagline: The ultimate choice for liver health, anti-cancer care, and immunity
sinsaengssam.description: Grown with incubator farming, Sinsaengssam contains over 800 times more Ginsenoside F2 in its leaves and stems compared to regular ginseng roots. Cultivated pesticide-free in a sterile environment, it can be safely consumed raw.
sinsaengssam.howToEat: Wash and eat raw, or use in salads, smoothies, or wraps. Recommended daily intake: 5-10 sprouts.
sinsaengssam.storage: Refrigerate (2-5°C), consume within 7 days of harvest
sinsaengssam.certification: Korea Food Research Institute analysis completed

doraji.name: Sinsaeng Doraji (Sprout Bellflower Root)
doraji.tagline: Nature's solution for bronchial and respiratory health
doraji.description: Incubator-farmed Sinsaeng Doraji contains 12 times more saponins than conventionally grown bellflower root. Young leaves and stems are harvested for a mild, tender taste that's enjoyable even raw.
doraji.howToEat: Eat raw, or prepare as side dish, tea, or juice. Recommended daily intake: 50-100g.
doraji.storage: Refrigerate (2-5°C), consume within 5 days of harvest
doraji.certification: Korea Food Research Institute analysis completed

garlic.name: Sinsaeng Garlic (Sprout Garlic)
garlic.tagline: Antibacterial food for cardiovascular health and immunity
garlic.description: Incubator-farmed Sinsaeng Garlic contains 8 times more allicin than regular garlic. Harvested at the sprout stage, it features a mild spiciness and crisp texture.
garlic.howToEat: Eat raw, or prepare as seasoned salad, stir-fry, or pickles. Recommended daily intake: 30-50g.
garlic.storage: Refrigerate (2-5°C), consume within 7 days of harvest
garlic.certification: Korea Food Research Institute analysis completed
